ma.getBackgroundFetchData

Obtain all data in the data pre-fetch cache. This API will wait for all pre-fetch requests to be completed (without using the last data), store all the pre-fetch data in a JsonArray and return it to the user (minimum version: 23.12.0)

Parameters

Attribute Type Default value Mandatory or Not Description
fetchType String Yes Cache data type, fixed value is pre
success Function No callback function for successful interface call
fail Function No Callback function for interface call failure
complete Function No The callback function at the end of the interface call (will be executed whether the call is successful or failed)

success callback function

Return Value
object
Attribute Type Description
data Array Cache data collection
data
Attribute Type Description
fetchedData String cached data
timeStamp Number The timestamp when the client gets the cached data
path String Page path
query String query parameters

Sample code

// ma.getBackgroundFetchData api
ma.getBackgroundFetchData({
  fetchType: 'pre',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.data[i].fetchedData); // Cached data
    console.log(res.data[i].timeStamp); // Timestamp when the client obtains cached data
    console.log(res.data[i].path); // Page Path
    console.log(res.data[i].query); // query Parameters
  }
});
